title: Let irrigators transform and trade their water rights (irrigation infrastructure operators)
what: Irrigation infrastructure operators in the Murray–Darling Basin must set clear procedures for irrigators to transform their irrigation rights, under the Water Market Rules.

sources.title: Water Market Rules 2009
sources.publisher: Federal Register of Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 6 Irrigation infrastructure operator to establish procedures for transformation (1) An irrigation infrastructure operator (not being an operator to whom subrule (2) applies) must establish clear procedures for the transformation, in accordance with these Rules, of the whole or a part of an irrigation right held against the operator and:

sources.title: Water Act 2007

assessment.summary: Irrigation operators must let irrigators convert and trade their water rights.

marks.reason: Operators cannot hold irrigators' water rights inside their networks, so water can trade more widely.
